messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate on route 'staged-deploy/v1' — ~40% 5xx and elevated p95. Automatic fallback to alternative variants triggered repeatedly. Paging @samir_oncall and @raj_sre

samir_oncall: ack, I'm on it. pulling traces and worker logs now.

samir_oncall: quick snapshot from traces: many requests show 'variant selection' step selecting opt-8b-q8, then immediate 502 from runtime -> fallback to nearest-region pool. repeated within 30s TTL.

maria_ops: how wide is this? which tenants impacted?

raj_sre: spike started ~12:07 UTC. errors concentrated in us-east-1 -> a lot of traffic falling back to us-west-2 and causing capacity thrash. enterprise tenants with session affinity are seeing retries.

elaine_prod: confirmed ACME and BetaCorp reporting slow/missing replies. Support has 3 open tickets and one priority escalation.

samir_oncall: hypothesis: staged deploy introduced a new model variant (opt-8b-q8) and the runtime's 'auto-variant' path picks it when memory pressure present. routing policy for staged traffic unintentionally allowed auto-variant escalation. Combined with short session-affinity TTL (30s) and region fallback the system is oscillating.

sre-lead-jess: can we stop the staged traffic immediately?

samir_oncall: doing a pause now. run: ```/api/admin/deploys/pause staged-deploy/v1 --force```
samir_oncall: pause returned success. traffic should be draining to stable pool; verifying.

incident-bot: Action logged: staged-deploy/v1 paused by samir_oncall at 1802003305.

maria_ops: applied temporary route override to pin enterprise tenants to stable-model cluster. config change: ```routes.override.enterprise = "stable-pool"``` — pushed.

elaine_prod: customer impact update: ACME saw 15% failed requests during window, multiple slow responses. AE looped in.

raj_sre: early RCA notes: (1) routing policy allowed auto-variant selection for staged namespace, (2) fallback policy prefers nearest region without safety-throttle, (3) session-affinity TTL small -> flip-flop. Combined effect = cascading fallback and retries.

samir_oncall: quick mitigation: disabled auto-variant-selection for staged namespace. change: ```routing.namespaces.staged.auto_variant = false``` -> reloaded runtime.

deploybot: config reload succeeded (deploybot).

raj_sre: monitoring metrics returning to baseline after pause + override. no new 5xx spikes for 20m.

sre-lead-jess: next steps: add explicit whitelist for allowed variants during staged windows, add safety throttle on cross-region fallback, and increase session-affinity TTL to reduce churn.

samir_oncall: filed a follow-up PR for whitelist + integration tests for variant selection. also recommending staged deploys explicitly set model variant in rollout metadata.

maria_ops: handing off to morning oncall: @raj_sre -> @ella_ops at 1802003900 for postmortem writeup and customer comms.

raj_sre: creating preliminary postmortem doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/1802003120-staged-deploy — adding timeline + evidence.

ella_ops: taking over. I'll coordinate with AE to push a short customer note and collect SLA impact. please add any logs/traces to the doc.

samir_oncall: current status: staged rollout paused, routing override in place, auto-variant disabled for staged. recommend not re-running until whitelist & tests are in.

sre-lead-jess: assign hotfix for fallback safety and sessions TTL to infra-team.

maria_ops: marking incident as mitigated for now; monitoring for 1 hour.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1802004120.
